methodology: Real write + readback observations against Meta Graph v25.0, plus runtime-rejection behavior proven by apb pre-flight guards. APPEND-ONLY: never rewrite or delete a prior observation; the Layer-1 scrape regenerates the documented index only and must never touch this file.
disclaimer: Absence of an entry means UNTESTED, not 'works'. An entry OVERRIDES the documented Layer-1 index on conflict. observed_result vocabulary: meta_rejected = Meta refused the write; accepted_unverified = write returned success but persistence could NOT be confirmed by readback; verified_applied = write succeeded AND a readback confirmed the new value; conditional = depends on entity state/context; unknown = documented but never live-tested.
evidence_note: evidence is a PUBLIC-SAFE citation token (this file ships in the public skill tarball). The full private audit trail (internal eval-doc paths + commit SHAs) lives in a sibling private evidence map that is never bundled.

entries.verification_notes: Accepted on POST (HTTP 200) but the field is NOT returned by `adset get` — persistence cannot be confirmed by readback. Report as 'accepted, not confirmable', never as 'updated'.

Budget TYPE is frozen at create — Meta rejects converting a campaign from daily to lifetime budget (or vice versa). The amounts are mutable; the type is not. apb fails this pre-flight (exit 2) before any network call.
entries.apb_command_example: apb campaign update <id> --lifetime-budget 50000 --execute   # rejected if campaign was created daily-budget

entries.verification_notes: Same as the campaign level: an ad set's budget type is frozen at create. Dayparting (adset_schedule) requires a lifetime budget, so it can only be added to ad sets created with a lifetime budget.
Meta v25 rejects 7-day and 28-day VIEW_THROUGH attribution windows (deprecated). Only 1-day view-through is accepted. apb validates and fails pre-flight (exit 2) with an actionable message.

DELETE of a value_rule_set is unsupported on all accounts/tokens tested (Meta: 'Unsupported delete request') — even for unattached sets; status is read-only too, so it cannot be deactivated via API. Workaround: rename to 'zzz-DELETE' and remove in Ads Manager UI.
entries.apb_command_example: apb value-rule delete --id <id> --execute   # surfaces Meta 'Unsupported delete request'

entries.verification_notes: LIVE-VERIFIED 2026-06-05 on a throwaway cc (Scandalous, unused pixel, then deleted): a POST updating custom_event_type (CONTENT_VIEW->LEAD) and a POST updating rule BOTH return {"success":true} / HTTP 200 — but a fields readback proves BOTH values are UNCHANGED. Meta SILENTLY IGNORES updates to these frozen fields. The mutable control (name) DID persist in the same test. Textbook 'API success != persisted' — always read back. To change a frozen field: delete + recreate.
entries.apb_command_example: apb custom-conversion update <id> --name 'New name' --execute   # name persists; custom_event_type/rule cannot be changed (silent no-op at Meta)

entries.verification_notes: LIVE-VERIFIED 2026-06-05: event_source_id is write-only — accepted at create but NOT returned by GET /<cc_id>?fields=event_source_id (Meta #100 'nonexisting field'). Like value_rule_set_ids: set-on-create, not read-back-able. Frozen + unreadable.
entries.apb_command_example: apb custom-conversion create ... (event_source_id set once at create)

entries.verification_notes: LIVE-VERIFIED 2026-06-05: DELETE /<cc_id> works (returns {"success":true}; a re-delete then errors 'Custom Conversion Already Deleted', confirming removal). QUIRK: deleted ccs remain enumerated in GET /act_<id>/customconversions as tombstones (hidden in Ads Manager UI, not editable/usable). Unlike value_rule_set, cc DELETE is genuinely supported.

EU DSA fields: required/expected when targeting EU countries. apb emits a non-fatal advisory (not a hard block) when EU targeting is present without beneficiary/payor — surface this to the user before the write.

Creative behavior depends on format-automation combinations; apb's creative auditor detects 11 FormatRisk variants (e.g. CAROUSEL+COLLECTION+FORMAT_AUTOMATION) and blocks before the write unless explicitly allowed. Outcome is state/spec-dependent, not a flat yes/no.
